newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Wilson County, Tenn.

text.p: General Obligation Public Works Bonds, Series 1997

Notice is hereby given that the County Executive of Wilson County, Tennessee (the ill receive sealed bids only for the purchase of the County's $5,800,000 General Obligation Public Works Bonds, Series 1997 (the
all or none, until 10:00 o'clock, a.m., C.S.T., on

at the offices of the County Executive, Wilson County Courthouse, Lebanon, Tennessee. The Bonds shall be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum. The Sale may be postponed upon notice given by Munifacts News Wire not less than twenty-four hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If the Postponement occurs, the sale will be held at the time and date announced via Munifacts News Wire at least forty-eight hours before the sale. The Bonds will be dated dEcember 15, 1996. The Bonds will mature on June 1 in the years 2007 through 2017, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety- nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the County Executive. Bonds are callable on June 1, 2000 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinion of Bass, Berry &Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the County. Additional information, including the Official Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the

undersigned at the Wilson County, Courthouse, Room 104, 228 East Main Street, Lebanon, Tennessee 37087, or from J.C. Bradford &Co., Attn: Tom McAnulty, 330 Commerce Street, Nashville, Tennessee 37201, telephone:(615) 748-9291.
